name: covenant_capped_leveraged_recap_share_count
question_template: Use exact arithmetic. A firm has unlevered asset value {V_U} USD million, existing debt {D0} USD million (carrying no tax-shield value) and {N} million shares. It plans to issue {B_REQ} USD million of new perpetual debt, pay an underwriting fee of {FEE} percent of the amount actually issued (a cash outflow that reduces firm value) and spend all net proceeds on a share repurchase. Each dollar of new debt issued adds {TAX} percent of face value in permanent tax-shield value. A covenant caps total debt (existing plus new) divided by post-repurchase equity value at {LIMIT}; if the planned issue would breach it, the issue is scaled down to the largest amount that exactly meets the limit. Post-repurchase equity value equals unlevered asset value plus tax shield minus fee minus total debt. Shares are repurchased at the self-consistent price: equity value just after the issue, with net proceeds still held as cash, divided by the original share count; retiring shares leaves the price unchanged. Report the number of shares outstanding after the repurchase, in millions.

slots.description: New debt actually issued after applying the covenant cap.
Self-consistent per-share price at which shares are repurchased.
Equity value remaining after the repurchase is completed.

program:
def solve():
    V = Q(P["V_U"])
    D0 = Q(P["D0"])
    N = Q(P["N"])
    B_req = Q(P["B_REQ"])
    f = Q(P["FEE"]) / 100
    t = Q(P["TAX"]) / 100
    L = Q(P["LIMIT"])
    # Covenant: (D0 + B) / (V + t*B - f*B - D0 - B) <= L  ->  largest B meeting it exactly
    b_max = (L * (V - D0) - D0) / (1 + L * (1 - t) + L * f)
    if b_max <= 0:
        raise ValueError("covenant already breached before any new issue")
    B = min(B_req, b_max)
    equity_after = V + t * B - f * B - D0 - B
    equity_with_cash = equity_after + B * (1 - f)
    price = equity_with_cash / N
    net_proceeds = B * (1 - f)
    shares_repurchased = net_proceeds / price
    shares_out = N - shares_repurchased
    return {
        "final": shares_out,
        "debt_issued": B,
        "repurchase_price": price,
        "equity_after": equity_after,
    }
